options.label: Do you currently have Finality (Combo gain disabled)?
options.tooltip: Explicit current Finality snapshot. The game keyword says skills cannot gain Combo during Finality. This control only gates the Combo generation view; it does not simulate buff duration, skipped strikes, or the Final Strike critical bonus. The per-event Combo view starts from an empty receiving counter and requires a successful eligible hit with another skill using the same bound weapon. No event frequency or automatic Combo spending is assumed.
